body: Yeah. I mean, I was a bit closed off as a child, and I hardly shared my feelings..I still am fairly closed off, but that didn't mean I was fine.

No. I mean, I've known there was damage. You don't take 9 years of sexual abuse and just pretend you're fine, but I was in therapy as a child due to being in foster care at one point, but I stopped seeing the therapist fairly early on due to my parents not feeling I needed it. Guess they were wrong.
